attributes.board_name: Kentucky Board of Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology

rules.accepted_credit_types: ASHA- or AAA-sponsored/approved programs and relevant accredited academic courses (1 credit hour = 15 h) without board review; board-approved programs incl. home study and in-service; presenting a new program or course (max half of the requirement); one published article (max half); related subjects max 4 h; online coursework max 10 h per day
rules.new_licensee_rule: A person newly licensed during the renewal period does not need CE for the first renewal.
rules.audit_note: Licensees list CE hours on the renewal; up to 15% are randomly audited and must show a professional-association transcript, certificate of completion or instructor affidavit. Keep records 2 years from renewal.

topics.who: All licensees: 2 hours focused on ethics, within the 30 (or 50 for dual licensure)

rules.notes: One CE hour = 60 minutes. Dual SLP and audiology licensees need 50 hours with CE in both areas. CE must be completed by January 31 of the renewal year; licenses renew biennially by January 31 (grace period to March 2, then expire March 3). Renewal fee $100 per license, $200 dual. Reinstatement after more than 5 years: 30 hours (50 dual) within the last 2 years.
